censoring_or_competing_events: Treatment/follow-up truncation implicit; death/dropout not modeled
state: Sequence of three recent multiparametric MRI states plus tumor masks and treatment-day embeddings
observation_decoder: Future multiparametric MRI, tumor segmentation, and pixelwise uncertainty maps
action_provenance: Observed treatment histories used as conditioning; hypothetical alternate schedules not validated
transition_mechanism: Treatment-aware conditional DDPM with joint segmentation and dilated longitudinal tumor weighting
maximum_horizon: Arbitrary future treatment day; empirically most reliable within 4 months, evaluated to 24+ months
rollout_regime: Direct conditional generation from recent observed scans; no autoregressive self-fed rollout
capability_claim: Treatment-aware future MRI/tumor-growth forecasting; supports treatment planning
baselines: Treatment-agnostic tumor-growth/image models and ablations; exact named strongest baselines partly in full tables
state_fidelity_metrics: MRI SSIM, PSNR, MSE; tumor Dice and RVD
transition_metrics: Metrics by patient, treatment-day range, and forecast interval
rollout_stability: Dice decline and uncertainty widening with longer interval; no self-conditioned rollout
action_sensitivity: Treatment conditioning and joint-learning ablations; no action shuffle, dose, or alternative-regime support test
calibration_and_uncertainty: Five stochastic samples; pixelwise standard deviation; no coverage/calibration assessment
external_validation: LUMIERE external cohort from a separate hospital, MRI-generation metrics only because masks unavailable
decision_utility: Potential scan/treatment planning discussed; no clinician-reader or outcome-utility study
statistical_analysis: Means±SD and correlation plots; small five-patient local test; no formal causal/statistical comparison reported
causal_language: Predicts how tumor will look for different treatment plans and treatment responses
estimand: Individual future image/tumor trajectory conditional on observed history and treatment label; not causally identified
counterfactual_validation: External imaging fidelity and observed-treatment prediction only; no randomized or target-trial validation
data_access: LUMIERE public; local SAILOR/request status NI
preprocessing_reproducibility: Registration, skull stripping, 1-mm resampling, per-channel z-score normalization, architecture, training, and sampling reported
randomness: Five stochastic inference samples; training seeds/repeated runs NI
evidence_anchors: pp.1-2 Abstract and Sec.I; pp.5-6 Secs.III-IV.A-B; pp.6-10 Sec.IV.C, Tables I-III, Figs.3-10; pp.12-13 Limitations and Sec.V
appraisal_strengths: Patient-level longitudinal modeling, treatment conditioning, separate external hospital, interval-stratified degradation, and uncertainty maps
appraisal_limitations: Very small local test, treatment confounding/support unaddressed, uncertainty uncalibrated, external set lacks tumor masks, and no alternate-treatment causal validation
source_status: Full peer-reviewed TMI/arXiv v5 PDF inspected
